children: Net Power executed three integrated agreements with Baker Hughes affiliates to reshape their oxy-combustion collaboration. The parties indefinitely suspended both the joint development and commercial agreements, ending Baker Hughes’ La Porte access and exclusivity, while leaving certain provisions in place. Separately, they amended the license to grant worldwide, perpetual industrial-scale rights with royalties tied to commercial plant operation and preserved Nuovo Pignone’s utility-scale exclusivity. The changes reflect market conditions and Net Power’s decision to halt near-term investment in the prior utility-scale program.
